description: Pre-registered research questions. No automated hypotheses or completed studies are claimed.

projects.question: How does starter pitch mix change against a specific projected lineup and how does that affect batter outcomes?
projects.mechanism: Pitcher target selection and lineup handedness alter pitch exposure and contact profiles
projects.null_hypothesis: Conditional matchup features do not improve unseen-game prediction versus a strong market and baseball-stat baseline
projects.target: Pregame batter outcomes and strikeout distribution

projects.question: When do potential-assist quality and teammate conversion improve point-guard assist projections beyond market baselines?
projects.mechanism: Pass recipient and defensive scheme determine shot conversion conditional on creation quality
projects.null_hypothesis: Potential-assist features do not improve held-out distributional assist predictions after minutes and opponent adjustment

projects.question: Which pregame offensive and defensive scheme interactions forecast play efficiency beyond rating baselines?
projects.mechanism: Coverage and pressure responses shift explosive play frequency and drive results
projects.null_hypothesis: Scheme covariates offer no predictive improvement over opponents and market ratings
projects.target: Pregame team points and game outcomes

projects.question: Do pretip roster quality and opponent-adjusted pace create consistent CBB forecast improvement?
projects.mechanism: Rotation-adjusted efficiency and matchup pace affect possession count and points
projects.null_hypothesis: Additional lineup effects do not improve walk-forward score distributions versus market and team baseline

projects.question: Can college baseball pitcher, lineup, game-result and contract data be linked without leakage?
projects.mechanism: Starting pitching and opposing lineup strengths affect run expectancy
projects.null_hypothesis: Available point-in-time data do not support reproducible forecasting

projects.question: Can point-in-time goalie deployment and shot quality improve goal distribution forecasts?
projects.mechanism: Opponent shot generation and confirmed goalie matchup alter scoring likelihood
projects.null_hypothesis: Goalie adjustment adds no held-out skill above market baseline

projects.question: Do lineup and tactical changes alter 1X2 probabilities beyond high-quality reference markets?
projects.mechanism: Player roles, fixture motivation and tactical formations alter chance creation
projects.null_hypothesis: Lineup features add no independent predictive skill

projects.question: Which court-surface and serve-return interactions predict matches beyond bookmaker baselines?
projects.mechanism: Matchups between opponent-adjusted serve/return and surface strengths affect hold and break rates
projects.null_hypothesis: No incremental skill beyond reference market
projects.target: Pregame match outcome and set distributions
